text: Elijah Eggleton is a human located at the Fallhaven in Drustvar.

Elmarine is a high elf mage. At some point after the Cataclysm, she visited Flayers' Point in Desolace where she was noticed by Aramar Thorne. One month later, she was encountered once again by Aram and his friends at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles where she acts as a keeper of peace between the tauren and quilboar that live in the reclaimed Post. Following the Fourth War, the jungle troll Zekhan reported that the Horde took control of Freewind Post. Whether the quilboar and Elmarine remain in the town is unknown.
Ellie Stephens is a human located at Stephen's Food Court in Boralus.
Elmo Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.

Corporal Eloise Hesterfield was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, she was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Gale's Reprieve, she would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, she is one of the Drowned Sailors.

Ellaene was a night elf Sentinel, the wife of Elyrion Fogsong, and the mother of Arietta. According to Elyrion, she was "Funny and quick and sweeter than honey to those she loved". Both Ellaene and Arietta were killed in a battle. Elyrion blamed himself for their deaths since he failed to supply the battle with healing potions, and subsequently isolated himself to become a hermit.
Elia Bladeleaf is a night elf located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. She is found stealthed with Dallio Morelli.

Ellemayne is a displaced night elf, from a timeline where the Burning Legion ruled Azeroth, located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Azq'roth Time Rifts. She starts The Resistance, one of the criteria of Temporal Acquisitions Specialist.
Elyssa Nightquiver is a night elf located at the Incursion in Krasarang Wilds.
Elva Stonechapel is a dwarf paladin located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Elton Black is a human found in the kitchen of Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Elria Willowfall is a night elf located at the Southport in Spires of Arak.
Elrondir Surrion is a blood elf located in the Frostwall's Gem Boutique. He accepts Blackrock Ores work orders creating Taladite Crystals.
Elthyn Da'rai is a blood elf demon hunter located in Orgrimmar Skyway.
Elsie Wright is a human located at the Bleak Hills Mine in Drustvar.
Elsa Donovan is a human located in Lost At Sea in Boralus. She joins up with the Dragonscale Expedition and can be found at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores.
Elsbeth Martinel is a human located at Eckhart Lodge in Stormsong Valley.

Emaedi Autoblast is a gnome member of G.E.A.R. who appears during the Heritage of Gnomeregan questline. She is a sharpshooter and scout for the 7th Legion, as well as an expert on explosives. She was one of the gnomes assembled in New Tinkertown by Captain Tread Sparknozzle and a gnome adventurer to form the Gnomish Elite Aerial Rangers, along with Herk Winklespring and Fizzi Tinkerbow. She subsequently traveled with the rest of G.E.A.R. first to the Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra to defend it from the Ironbound troggs, and then to the Foot Steppes and the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks to track down the troggs' master, Telzo Sparkspanner. She and the rest of G.E.A.R. fina

Elyrion Fogsong is an elderly and very skilled night elf alchemist. After suffering a great personal loss, he chose to live alone in a bog on the slopes of Mount Hyjal, but this ultimately changed as the result of his friendship with the Sentinel Keda Bloomblade.
Elynae Dawnbreaker is a blood elf located in Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.

Emery Neill is a human found in King's Square in Old Stratholme. He ran the Stone Crow Tavern. He appears in the Deaths of Chromie. It is revealed that he was in love with Orphan Matron Meliana. After the adventurer helps him, he's tipped off to the occurrences with Arthas and the culling outside. He is prepared to burn his bar down, to prevent his death and the area being overtaken, and asks the adventurer to get him the necessary supplies to do so without injuring himself.
Emi is a human child found inside The Wonderworks in Dalaran.

Emerine Junis is a human mage who spent the last few years as prisoner in the Kurzen compound after denying Colonel Kurzen's advances. The Kurzen Compound Prison Records list no offical crime, only that she was ordered incarcerated for 75 years by Colonel Kurzen himself. After being freed Emerine desired to finish up her research on the Altar of Naias. After getting Heart of Naias she plans to take it back to the Kirin Tor. She can be summoned by using the Emerine's Telling-Sphere.
Emily Jackson is a human stable master located in Refuge Point in the Arathi Highlands.
Emily Cole is a human found at the Timeless Isle. She is also the owner of Pierre. Chief Engineer Jard is her friend.

Emek is a TCG character that appears on the following cards: *Fields of Honor #13 - Emek the Equalizer *Drums of War #197 - Tormentor Emek *Blood of Gladiators #127 - Gladiator Emek Quotes from him and references to him can be found on the following cards: *"I'd rather be knocked unconscious than have to take another hit from that." - Blackout Truncheon *"One after another, they fell to his blade, as the rest of us looked on in horror." - Blood Strike *"It's ... not ... OVER!" - Darkest Before the Light *"It pains me that the only peace I can give Emek is in battle." - Gladiator Kaniya *"For those who are faithful, death is only temporary." - Sacred Circle
Emily Mayville is a witch disguised as a human located in Drustvar. She is found weeping by the Lost Sailors' Memorial.
Emigos was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. His name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Emerald Helper is a faerie dragon whelp who might appear during Dreamsurges. The adventurer has the Dreamsurge Helpers buff when the helper is accompanying them.

Emissary Skyhaven is the night elf Alliance ambassador to the Kalu'ak in Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight, under the guidance of Elder Ko'nani. She and her Horde counterpart Envoy Ripfang seem to be giving the Elder a headache.

Emissary Brighthoof is the leader of the Westwind Refugee Camp. Horde adventurers encounter her during The Fall of Taunka'le Village quest chain. In order to renew the Taunka's spirit she asks Horde adventurers to retrieve 10 Horde Armaments so the Taunka Refugees can be offically inducted into the Horde. After which, she gives the adventurer a Blood Oath of the Horde to induct the taunkas.
Empyrean was the hippogryph of Isalien, a member of the mercenary-company Veiled Blade. When fighting her, she will eventually summon Empyrean to assist her.

Emperor Dojan II was an emperor of the mogu. Even by mogu standards, the reign of Emperor Dojan II was short and brutish. His maniacal drive to finish his father's work and complete the great Purge against the rebellious saurok legions drove him to leave his court in disarray while he set out on a doomed military campaign. From his perch high on the cliffs overlooking the Krasarang Wilds he oversaw the slow clear-cutting of the jungle, the establishment of Dojanni Dungeons, and the gradual genocide of the saurok race. What he didn't expect was for the remains of the saurok fifth and seventh legions to scale the enormity of the cliffs in the dead of night, ambushing his imperial pavilion from

Emperor Rikktik was a hozen emperor of Pandaria. During the short reign of the Hozen Emperor Rikktik, a terrible fever swept through the Valley of the Four Winds. He was entombed in Emperor Rikktik's Rest, with his tiny chest, which contains some gold and his tick remover.

Emperor Tsao was an emperor of the mogu. Very little is known about this emperor, other than his reign was short and unremarkable by mogu standards, notable mostly for administrative reorganization. He was the only mogu emperor that was actually liked among the pandaren as he permitted the pandaren slaves, by imperial edict, to read, write and establish their own schools. A statue of his likeness, kept in respect of his memory, remains on the eastern coast of the Jade Forest, while most others were removed after the revolution.

Emma Strikken is a human located in the Lunarfall's Garrison. She sells reagents. Upon reaching Tier 3, she is found in two spots at the same time, at the farmhouse next to the Druid of the Talon cave entrance and at the entrance of the Tower of War.
Emperor Wai was a mogu emperor. His snarling face was depicted on coins that were used as currency during his time.
Emmarel Shadewarden is a night elf huntress of the Unseen Path. She has a pet eagle named Snowfeather.
Emma Swiftwind is a human located in Tiragarde Sound. She is part of Taelia Fordragon's patrol squad.
Emily Vaccar is a human located in Nethergarde Keep in Blasted Lands.
Emrul Riknussun is a dwarf cooking vendor located at the Bronze Kettle by the Great Forge within Ironforge.
Emtheas Trueeye is a night elf druid of the Ashen located in Val'sharah.
Enchanter Nalthanis is a high elf Grand Master enchanting trainer located in the Simply Enchanting shop in Dalaran.
Enchanter Isian is a high elf heirloom vendor found in the Silver Enclave in Dalaran.
Enchanter Farendin is a blood elf found in the Godan's Runeworks shop in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen standing in front of the building.

Enchantress Herim is a blood elf located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. She can be found outside the Dawnstrider Enchanters business, speaking with Teg Dawnstrider. She used to provide arcane reforging, but now directs players to the ethereals in Orgrimmar's Drag for their reforging needs.
Enderman was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Endora Moorehead is a human vendor found inside Sisters Sorcerous in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was meditating.
Engineer Draxen is an orc located at the Draxen's Workshop in Talador.
Engineer Horthuk was an orc located on a train in Gorgrond and taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Engineering Follower is a human appearing in Lunarfall and Frostwall.
Enduring Defenses is a Protection warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Massacre.
Enduring Chill is a Frost death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Piercing Chill.
Energizing Brew is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Lifecycles.
Enforcer Grant is a human located in front of Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. He serves Count Clessington as a leading attendant.
Enforcer Jennive is a human located on a bridge leading to Northshire Vineyards in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. She serves Count Clessington as a leading attendant.
Enforcer Tera is a human located behind Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. She serves Count Clessington as a leading attendant.
Enforcer Horb is a human located at the entrance to the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. He serves Count Clessington as a leading attendant.
Engineer Combs is a member of the crew of the Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. He sells more than just engineering supplies and also does repairs.
Engineer Brightbuckle is a member of the crew of The Bravery, the boat that runs between Stormwind Harbor and Teldrassil. He sells general good supplies and also does repairs.

Engineer Torquespindle is a member of The Maiden's Fancy, the boat that runs between the ports of Ratchet and Booty Bay. He'll gladly sell you anything you might require on your short trip between ports.
Entrapment is a hunter talent located in tier 2 of the Survival tree.
Entropius is a void god into which the naaru M'uru transforms during the fifth boss encounter of the Sunwell Plateau. Some parts of M'uru's form are still visible.
Ensign Ward is a human found aboard The Skyfire above Stormwind Harbor and the Cove of Nashal. She is later found in Valdisdall in Stormheim. She has a Greywatch Gryphon.
Ensign Josey is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Enyo was a jungle troll mage trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, standing near Deino and Pephredo.

Epidemic is a Death knight talent located in the Unholy Tree. The damage dealt per second of the diseases is unchanged, so the talent causes the diseases to deal more total damage over their full durations.

Envoy Ripfang is an orc Horde ambassador to the Kalu'ak in Moa'ki Harbor, under the guidance of Elder Ko'nani. He and his Alliance counterpart Emissary Skyhaven seem to be giving the Elder a headache.
Eorain Dawnstrike is a blood elf enchanting trainer located inside Warsong Hold next to the lift to the roof in the Borean Tundra.

Erdunor Whitespire is a Highborne night elf located at Thistlefuzz Arcanery in Ironforge. He is seen talking to Gimble Thistlefuzz. He is apparently related to Ithurian Whitespire and Aladrel Whitespire, two other Highborne magi who have settled in Stormwind and Darnassus, respectively.
Envoy Karlog was an orc Twin Peaks battlemaster located in Thunder Bluff during the monthly Call to Arms: Twin Peaks.

Envoy Sheelah is a blood elf found slain within Kargathia Keep. She was sent as a sin'dorei ambassador to the Warsong Clan, though was killed by a kaldorei assassin. Her guardian Menerin blames himself for not being able to protect her.

Ephial is a human necromancer found in Admiral Taylor's Farm in western Spires of Arak. After the Alliance established their garrison in Arak, Taylor noticed that Ephial was obsessed with ley lines. When a group of lumberjacks disappeared, Ephial and Nas Dunberlin went to clear the area of wasps. A few days later, the Iron Horde attacked and Ephial went missing after the fighting but subsequently returned. Wrathion told Taylor to keep an eye on Ephial. When Taylor left for the Ring of Blood arena battles, Ephial took control of the garrison. After Taylor returned, he was determined to put things right but Ephial turned on his comrades, killed everyone in the garrison and raised them as ghost
Eran Droll is a Darkfallen death knight located at Acherus: The Ebon Hold. He only appears after completing the Frost and Death class hall advancement, letting you train Ebon Knight Frostreavers.
Erdin Fain is a human located at the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Erdi Bloodtooth is an orc innkeeper located in Stormsong Valley.

Envoy Korg is an orc located in Razor Hill Barracks in Durotar. Orc players who have completed the Heritage of Draenor quest chain can speak with Korg and change which orcish clan that they pledge allegiance to.

Eon's Fringe is a dragon-held area in southern Thaldraszus. A sanctuary from PvP combat, the area is stuck in a temporal anomaly, and all inhabitants have been frozen in time. Players can unlock an Ancient Waygate immediately to the north at inside a tower. While in the area, players are afflicted with: : :: :: The area is bordered by the Flowing Forest to the north, the Shifting Sands to the east, the Temporal Conflux to the southeast, and the Winterpelt Hollow of Azure Span to the west. Inhabitants, all frozen in time, include Observer Assistant Ata, Observer Koro, Guardians Kaine and Shoka fighting two Time Trapped Bears, Aoagosa coming in to land near Kavigos and Gardener Bubti, Gardener
Eranthi is a man'ari eredar located in the Putrid Laboratory in the Antoran Wastes. She is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.
Eran'nda is a night elf located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.

Erion Shadewhisper is a night elf rogue trainer located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He is found in the Hall of Shadows. Erion participated in the Battle for Darkshore, manning the Glaiveworks.
Erma is a human stable master located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

Erlan Drudgemoor is a hostile human who resides at Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest. He can be found inside the house with his colleagues Surena Caledon and Morgan the Collector. Unlike Surena and Morgan, there are no quests related specifically to him. Before the Defias Brotherhood's fall, he convinced Surena Caledon to leave her studies under Gakin the Darkbinder and join him as a member of the Brotherhood instead.
Erin Kelly is a human artisan tailoring trainer located at Odesyus' Landing in Azuremyst Isle.

Erefor Pelija is a member of the Defias Brotherhood. He was one of the architects in charge of rebuilding Stormwind. He helped design the eastern merchants' block. Brann Bronzebeard had worked under him during the construction. Brann ran into him during a trip in Westfall. Erefor did not remember him. They had a chat together, allowing Brann to learn a little bit about the Brotherhood. Erefor sends a bill to Stormwind quarterly asking for payments due with interest.

Erin Von Halnor is a human Alliance emissary to Duskwood. He resides in the Scarlet Raven Inn. Brann Bronzebeard once encountered him, and discussed information about the region. Erin told him that the townspeople were so desperate to rid themselves of many of their woes that crime had relatively ceased in the town; the town had banded together behind the mayor and the Night Watch militia.

Erthalif was an high elf mage that died three hundred years before the Third War. Aegwynn was given access to his redoubt after his death. It took her and Erthalif's old staff ten weeks just to organize the scrolls, scrub away the desiccated food and drink, and chase off the vermin. The Guardian then found notes taken by the legendary elf wizard Kithros in the library and use them to write a new banishment spell.

Erk is a level 2 orc child found near the watch tower little north of Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He brings Guard Kurall and the other guards some fresh fish from the nearby lake. He has a pet wolf called Fang. He was rescued by adventurers during the Legion Invasions.
Ertog Ragetusk is an orc found at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
Eriyala is a blood elf trade good vendor located in the Tenebrous Cavern in the Abyssal Depths.
Ernest Slabstuff is a Dark Iron dwarf general goods vendor located at Iron Summit in the Searing Gorge.
Erick Nateson is a human located at the Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
Eric is a human located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

Eric Broadoak is a human scribe and alchemist originally found in the Scribe's Quarters of the Lunarfall garrison on alternate Draenor. Eventually, he would fully join the Alliance military and was stationed onboard the Skyguard gunship, becoming Battle Alchemist Broadoak. He would provide supplies to Alliance soldiers preparing to enter into battle against the nearby Horde over control of the :Azerite resource.
Esmund Brightshield is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Erika Page is a human found in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

Ernest Carlisle is a human alchemist located in Marl's Stead in Val'sharah. He owned a cottage and lived in Gilneas. He earned quite the reputation for his unconventional methods and was shunned from Gilneas long ago. He was once known as Mad Ernie and worked with Ritssyn Flamescowl, who during the third invasion of the Burning Legion sent adventurers to him in order to aid Shinfel Blightsworn in combating her doom curse. After helping him herd his goats and obtaining ingredients from various areas of Val'sharah, Ernie created an elixir for Shinfel.
Ericus Deathbringer is a human located in Acherus: The Ebon Hold, found wandering about the upper level.
Eriah Dawnsbane is a human rogue located in Underbelly of Dalaran.
Erupting Souls is a Vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Lingering Ordeal and Flaming Soul traits.

Erwill Youngton is a high-ranking member of the kingdom of Stormwind. Long before any of the Great Wars, its kingdom felt it was unable to do everything it wanted to within the law, and so Erwill secretly approached a thief in the prisons called Pathonia Shaw. She had been imprisoned repeatedly for theft, caught perhaps three times at most, and she was notorious for scores of high profile crimes. Youngton offered her clemency if she agreed to form a society to take care of Stormwind's dirty work quickly and cleanly. She agreed at once—and added that she would find a way to do it with a sense of style as well. The Stormwind Assassins began that day. With the agreement of Erwill Youngton, she
Erul Dawnbrook is a blood elf located in Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Erma Milforth is a drunk woman located in That's A Moray in Boralus.
Eric Covington is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Eric Eades is a human located in Layson & Sons Rigging in Stormsong Valley.
Essence Sever is an Azerite trait available to Vengeance demon hunters.
Escaped Stonetalon Prisoner is an orc located in Southern Barrens.
Ericon is a human archmage who fought outside Dalaran against Arthas Menethil and the Scourge when Kel'Thuzad was summoning Archimonde during the Third War.
Erzadormu is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.
Eternal Agony is an Unholy death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Feast of Souls (death knight artifact trait), Scourge the Unbeliever and The Darkest Crusade traits.
Estynna Starlance is a night elf ghost located in the Ruins of Nar'thalas of Azsuna. She was found by her children 10 000 years after her death with the help of a class order leader.
Esther MacMillan is a human located in Crosswind Commons in Boralus. She is surrounded by Seabreeze Gulls.
Eugene Daller is a Forsaken warrior trainer located at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Ethan Graveborn is a Forsaken mage located in Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest of Pandaria. He is keeping a portal open between Orgrimmar and Honeydew Village.

Ethylar was a high elf mage at Nallorath's father court and a member of the Council of Tirisfal 2,600 years before the First War. She battled against Kathra'natir who stole the Amulet of Waters. Ethylar's Council predecessor created the spiders of Venomweb Vale to secure the area as a meeting place, a fact she did not appreciate as she loathed and feared insects. When Kathra'natir was directing a locust swarm at the edge of Silverpine Forest, the Council confronted him but without a Spearhead, they could only attack with their individual spells. Unaffected, Kathra'natir sent the swarm at them; Ethylar froze up due to her phobia and couldn't shield herself, which proved fatal when the nathrez
Evanesce is a mage talent available at level 15. It replaces Ice Block, giving the mage a significantly weaker defensive cooldown that is available much more frequently.
Evanra Cloudchant is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Evelune Soulreaver is a night elf located in the Fel Hammer over Mardum.
Eve Fredrickson is a human ghost located to the left of the Bank of Dalaran in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.

Evan O'Shivers was a human located at the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. He assisted Camille Kleister, freezing Trader Caelen's cart. He died when it exploded in a fel fire, leaving his body on the stairs of The Agronomical Apothecary. Deucus Valdera then referred to him as a smoldering corpse.
Euphemia Batten-Chase is a human located at North Pass Caverns in Drustvar.
Ethereal Sensitivity is an Arcane mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Aegwynn's Ascendance, Aegwynn's Wrath, Force Barrier, and Sloooow Down traits.

Evan Morris was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Drustvaria, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Eugene Fulton is a human fish vendor located in Falconhurst in Drustvar.
Etga is a Mag'har orc located at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar.
Ethidris Creekward is a night elf located in the Root-Bound Sanctuary in the Emerald Dream.
Evie Stormstout was a member of the Stormstout family. She was killed by the mantid at the Horrid March in Dread Wastes. She looked like Li Li.
Examiner Rahm Flameheart is a member of the Reliquary, found in Warspear Outpost, Ashran. He is discussing the search for a mysterious artifact with Illandria Belore.

Eversong Woods is the blood elf starting zone, designed for levels 1-10. Much of the questing experience is dedicated to containing and repairing the damage done in the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas during the Third War, as well as dealing with the Wretched, Alliance spies, and Amani trolls. Unlike many starting zones, which feature fairly directed questing experiences, there are many quest hubs scattered around Eversong Woods. Breadcrumb quests help players navigate the zone in an optimal order.

Sir Evran was a knight of the army of the who was killed during the battle with the in . He was one of the first to die, leapt upon and killed by 's enormous hammer in the space of a single heartbeat.
Everlasting Hunt is a Vengeance demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Everburning Consumption is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Big Mouth and Phoenix Reborn (artifact trait) traits.
Excavator Morgrum Emberflint is a Dark Iron dwarf located the Alliance camp in Xibala in Zuldazar.
Exadria is a black dragon accompanying Sabellian in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Eviscerator Kintara is an orc from Warlands located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.

Exotic Beasts is a level 10 Beast Mastery hunter passive. It allows the hunter to tame beasts in the following pet families: *Aqiri *Carapid *Chimaera *Clefthoof *Core hound *Devilsaur *Pterrordax *Shale beast *Spirit beast *Stone hound *Water strider *Worm

Executor Cornell is the leader of the Forsaken forces that were occupying Emberstone Village, and is known for his unbound ruthlessness. He is slain by the Worgen adventurers during the Worgen starting experience, and Emberstone is freed from the Forsaken.
Exiled Stargazer is an orc located in Exile's Rise in . He is standing next to Kat'la.
Exotic Munitions is a passive hunter talent, available at level 100.
Executioner's Precision was an Arms warrior artifact trait. It was linked to the Soul of the Slaughter and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Expedition Leader Augustus is a member of the Ashvane Trading Company sleeping next to a tent in the western part of the Ashvane Encampment in Vol'dun.
Exhausted Hunter is a human located in Beacon Hill in Stormsong Valley.
Expedition Scout Mirwen is a night elf located in Apex Observatory in the Waking Shores.
Explosive Shot is a row 10 hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Barrage.
Explorers' League Surveyor is a dwarf located at Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.
Explosive Force is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Raptor's Cry, Aspect of the Skylord and Hunter's Guile traits.
Expose Weakness is a hunter talent located on tier 7 of the Survival tree.
Extended Healing is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Infusion of Life, Way of the Mistweaver, and The Mists of Sheilun traits.
Extractor Thelsara is a human located in the Fleshrender's Workshop in Blackwing Descent. She and her fellow cultists are using the workshop to experiment on dragon whelps.
Face is an elite gnome and member of the G-Team, a small group within S.A.F.E.
Fae Spirit is a ghostly faerie dragon located at the Shan'ze Dao in Townlong Steppes.

Eyir is a titanic watcher val'kyr and the leader of the Valarjar Val'kyr, notably charged with finding glorious combatants to ascend to the Halls of Valor. Ascended vrykul shieldmaidens of the Valkyra battle to prove their worth to Eyir and become Val'kyr in order to serve eternally in the Halls of Valor. She is called a "goddess" by Ashildir. Eyir has some sort of history with the loa Bwonsamdi, and it does not seem to be a positive one.
Face Palm is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Obstinate Determination, Hot Blooded and Dragonfire Brew (artifact trait) traits.
Fae'lio is a blood elf located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. He is a member of the Untitled Band.
Falkan Armonis is a human reagent vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Fairbreeze Village is a blood elf village in southern Eversong Woods just west of the Dead Scar and close to the Sunsail Anchorage. Fairbreeze is the place where many young adventurers learn their trades, before venturing forth into Ghostlands and Tranquillien.

Fahrad was a black dragon that had been in disguise who saved Wrathion when he was still in his egg. He remained loyal to his new prince even when Deathwing returned. He is a quest giver and rogue trainer located in Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Faelyssa is a night elf located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Faldoc Stonefaith is a dwarf paladin trainer located inside the inn in the town of Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

Falgran Hastil is a human located in Foothold Citadel on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. He appears after Suspicious Hoofprints (Alliance) is turned in. He hasn't been seen since. It is unknown if he participated in the Attack on Theramore Isle and if he survived.
Falda Fardelve is a dwarf archaeology trainer located along the trainers row on the southern side of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

Faldir was a human of Strom and one of the last members of Thoradin's line to dwell in the empire of Arathor, around 1,200 BDP. With the gradual fracturing of Arathor into independent kingdoms and the departure of Strom's noble families from the capital, Faldir led the last living descendants of Thoradin across the sea to the southern parts of the Eastern Kingdoms, where they had heard rumors of a lush, unplumbed land where they could make a new beginning. The rumors proved true, and in this new land, Thoradin's descendants founded the kingdom of Stormwind. Faldir's Cove near Stromgarde is named after him, apparently marking the spot where he and his followers began their voyage across the s

Falara Nightsong is a night elf demon hunter first encountered at the Illidari Foothold in Mardum. She was freed from the Vault of the Wardens and traveled to the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. During the Legion Invasions, she was found at all of the Illidari camps around Azeroth. During that time, she had the title of "Illidari Provisioner". She also became the blacksmith of Vengeance Point on the Broken Shore. She can be found at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus as the Time Rifts vendor for Azewrath items.
Faith Renewed was a Holy priest honor talent, available at rank 8.
Fafnir Hammerbeard is a dwarf and the brother of Eliezer. He translated a legend about the Hellslayer, Godfighter, and Dragon Hunter.
Falania Nightsoul is a void elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Faelie Seawhisper is a night elf located in Mezzamere in Nazjatar.
Failure is a projection of a nightmare dragon located in Ardenweald.
Falastrasz is a red dragon located in the Late Night Lab in Thaldraszus. He is found chatting with Shimidormi and Osithra.
Faerie Drake is a faerie dragon located in Verdant Landing in Emerald Dream.

Fanghorn was a tauren member of the Twilight's Hammer. He was a part of the group assisting Garona Halforcen in ruining the peace treaty between the Horde and the Alliance. He was killed by Garona's son, Med'an.

Fanny Thundermar is a Wildhammer dwarf member of the Wildhammer clan. She is the sister of Colin Thundermar. She is married to Keegan Firebeard during the Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding and is thereafter known as Fanny Firebeard. On the , Fanny and her husband tend to the stables at Lunarfall, the Alliance Garrison. They are joined by Sky'reen, the daughter of the late gryphon Sky'ree and whose egg they received as a wedding gift. She traveled with her husband to the Dragon Isles. They are found at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.

Fanlyr Silverthorn is a blood elf encountered on Pandaria. He directs members of the Reliquary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and Kun-Lai Summit, and travels as part of Lor'themar Theron's retinue to various other points of interest.
Fangs is a felbat that accompanied Shieldbreaker Murdonn when they invaded Dalaran. At Krasus' Landing, they were taken out by the champions of the Class Orders.

Fangcaller Sraka is the leader of the Faithless sethrak's attack on the Abandoned Burrows in Vol'dun. Nisha asks adventurers to help her kill Sraka, who is in possession of a strategic map drawn by Nisha.
Falthir Dawnbreak is a blood elf found at Falcon Watch on the Hellfire Peninsula.
Falron Greygold is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Fargon Mortalak is a dwarf armor vendor located at the Plate-n-Chain in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Farmer Saldean is a human bread vendor located at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. During the Legion Invasions, his farm was attacked by demons, but adventurers saved him and Salma.
Farmer Getz was a level 24 human found near Hillsbrad Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills. High Executor Darthalia wanted Getz killed in order to disrupt the humans' food supply and infrastructure.

Farmer Ray was a level 23 human found near Hillsbrad Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was located on the second floor inside a house at and was a cousin to Phin Odelic. His dog Stanley was poisoned by Apothecary Lydon as a test and turned into Enraged Stanley, forcing Ray to put him down. High Executor Darthalia wanted Ray killed in order to disrupt the humans' food supply and infrastructure. The remains of Farmers Ray, Getz and Kalaba now form the .
Farstrider Dusking is a blood elf found in the Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.
Farseer Corhuk is a Mag'har orc found in Garadar in Nagrand.
Farmer Leon is a human found at the Great Forge in Ironforge. This pig farmer gave players on Korean servers, who attended the Blizzard Worldwide Invitational 2007 and provide a code, a Fortune Coin.
Farmer Torp is an orc located west of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.

Farseer Gadra is a jungle troll member of the Earthen Ring found in the Damplight Chamber of the Shimmering Expanse. He shares a vision with the adventurer of a threat posed by the elementals and a naga attack.
Farseer Tooranu is a Broken shaman member of the Earthen Ring located in Grim Batol. He requests that Drahga Shadowburner be killed and the Missive to Cho'gall be brought to him.
Farina is a Mag'har orc child that sells all Hallow's End masks including special 5-use masks.
Farmer Krella is an orc located at the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Farmer Lok'lub and Farmer Krella are found at Frostwall if the Barn is built.

Farand was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He and his thane, Kurdran Wildhammer, were the first to notice the orcs in the Hinterlands after their retreat from Hillsbrad. He and Iomhar later assisted Kurdran to battle the red dragons ridden by orcs that attacked the Third Fleet. While he apparently survived the war his status remains unknown.
Farseer Urquan is a Frostwolf orc found in Throm'var in Frostfire Ridge.
Fasani is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Farstrider is a level 45 Beast Mastery and Marksmanship hunter talent.
Natin was a human farmer located at the Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm. He hired Apprentice Andrethan to shoe his horses. He was killed when Kael'thas Sunstrider dropped a mana bomb on the village.

Farmer Goldfield is a human located at Goldfield Farmstead in Stormsong Valley. He often says Mayor Roz he is alright, but she often worries about him, since he lives near the quilboar. His father gave him a gun, and he has been shooting the quilboar since then. However, when the Briarbacks did attack, they killed wife and son, so he had to hole up in his house, leaving behind his keepsakes. He refused to leave when the Alliance emissary found him. Instead, he gave them his knive and asked them to retrieve his ammunition from the quilboar. Intending to avenge his family, they made war on the quilboar on the farm. Once Brug Housesmash was killed, he asked for flowers in order to lay his famil
Farbrahm Steelfist is a dwarf located in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.
Farmer Burton is a human located in Burton Farmstead in Stormsong Valley.
Farmer Max is a human located in the Amber Waves in Stormsong Valley.

Father Malgor Devidicus is a human priest located within the inn of Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula. He appears to be quite the patron of the bar there. He is linked to Arator the Redeemer — as he was Turalyon's friend 15 years ago — who can be overheard telling the bartender, Sid Limbardi, that Father Malgor Devidicus "may be the only link" he has to his mother's and father's life.
Father Levariol is a human priest standing in Westguard Keep of Howling Fjord.
Father Michaels is a human priest located in the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.
Fedli Caskcheer is a dwarf food and drink vendor located in the small camp of Gunstan's Dig in Tanaris.
Featherbeard was an honored Wildhammer dwarf who was a gryphon breeder and trainer. He lived in Featherbeard's Hovel.
Fearsome Jang is a pandaren monk located at the Peak of Serenity in the Kun-Lai Summit.
Favra Bearhide is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can be recruited from the Frostwall Tavern building via Akanja.
Father Timothy is a human located in Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar after the completion of Jungle Escort.
Faye is a human located in Tempest's Edge at Stormsong Valley that is near Daven.

Feero Ironhand was a human located at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. He worked alongside Delgren the Purifier to undermine the Cult of the Dark Strand. Following the Cataclysm, Feero died while defending Maestra's Post against the Horde's attack. His hammer was subsequently recovered and sent to the Argent Dawn embassy in Darnassus.
Fel Hellweaver is a fel orc located in the Hellfire Antechamber in .
Fel Lord Caza is a fel lord located at the Cryptic Hollow on Mardum.
Fel Infusion is a demon hunter weapon set. Both of these warglaives are awarded after Return to the Black Temple or can be purchased from Demissya Gladestrider on the Fel Hammer.
Fel Lord Betrug is a fel lord and one of the possible end bosses of the Assault on Violet Hold dungeon.
Fel Barrage is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Glaive Tempest.
Fel Lord Darakk is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Kurrz is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Razzar is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Kurduz is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Fel Lord Rakkan is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Fel Lord Zardak is a fel lord located on the beach of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Feenix Arcshine is a goblin mage trainer located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar.
Fel Defender is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market and the Sun King's Salvation in Castle Nathria.
Felder Stover is a human weapon vendor located at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes.
Felaana is a night elf trade goods vendor located in Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
Fel Overseer Mudlump is a rare elite orc located behind the gates of in Tanaan Jungle.
Felblade is a demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Aura of Pain.
Felbringer Xar'thok is a fel lord located at the Garrison of the Fel on the Broken Shore.
Felecia Gladstone is a human located in Beacon Hill and the Clearcut in Stormsong Valley.
Felspark Ravine is a demon-infested scar running east to west, north of the Legion Front in Hellfire Peninsula. It is inhabited by imps, dreadlords, and infernals.

Felmyst is a fel dragon and the third boss of the Sunwell Plateau raid. She is raised from the corpse of the blue dragon Madrigosa when the blood of the slain pit lord Brutallus seeps into the ground and flows beneath her body. Felmyst is the final boss encounter before reaching Agamath, the First Gate. Felmyst drops the last of the 8 tier 6 tokens.
Felindel Sunhammer is a blood elf blacksmith vendor found at the Sunreaver's Command in the Crystalsong Forest.
Felros is a night elf located at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. He was present at the grove when the Horde invaded it during the War of the Thorns.
Felhunter Minion is the felhound minion of Durak, an orc warlock in the Splintertree Mine at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
Felinda Frye is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman of the Earthen Ring located in the Heart of Azeroth.
Felsmith Haldoor is a man'ari eredar blacksmith who was taken out in Faronaar by the champions of the Conclave who arrived there to get his Lumenstone.
Felweaver Scornn is a rare mob orc warlock found in Skull Rock in Durotar. His pet is a Voidwalker Minion.
Fendrig Redbeard is a dwarf miner as part of the Valiance Expedition and member of the Explorers' League found in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Ferlynn Windsong is a night elf Sentinel located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. Equipped with bow and quiver, she is practicing her archery alongside Heldgarr Steelbeard.

Ferelyn Bloodscorn was a blood elf member of the Argent Dawn. He was the first to accept Darion Mograine's call for help in storming Naxxramas to rescue his father, Alexandros Mograine. He was also the first of the party to die, getting injected with the plague by Grobbulus and then thrown into a pool of toxic sludge.
Fergus Gravelsmash is a Dark Iron dwarf blacksmith vendor located at Iron Summit in the Searing Gorge.

Fergun is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon rider. He was stationed at Allerian Stronghold, looking after Kurdran Wildhammer's gryphon after his presumed death. He was alarmed when Grizzik was petting Sky'ree and Danath asked him to stand back, for he believed Grizzik was harmless. It's unknown what became of him.
Ferment is the Brewmaster monk secondary stat attunement, focusing on critical strike.

Fen Cinderpaw is a pandaren fire mage located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Fern Greenfoot is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Feonir Cloudthistle is a night elf innkeeper of the Traveler's Den in Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Fenistrasza's Skull is the skull of a presumed red dragon. The skull is a trophy belonging to Tarjin the Blind, who slew Fenistrazsa by holding her in a volcano for three days straight.
Ferio Stillwind is a night elf located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.

Field Marshal Snowfall is a dwarf located at the Scarab Dais in Silithus alongside Master Sergeant Fizzlebolt during the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday. Snowfall, along with his Horde counterpart Warlord Gorchuk, is a callback to the massive item funneling that took place during the War Effort to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. As his gossip text hints at, players on the entire realm ended up focusing their efforts to get a single player his or her The Scepter of the Shifting Sands to bang the gong and start the war.
Field Merchant Skevin is a human located in Krasarang Wilds.
Field Marshal Rohamus is a human located at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula. He's the leader of the fel reaver disassembly there.
Ferra Pearl is a night elf druid located in A Little Patience scenario.
